title: Fate Scribe
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji paid the price of ten years of lifespan for the Fate Scribe, Ling Yuan, thousands of miles away, suddenly opened his eyes—on his path of pursuit, an unprecedented mist had appeared.

text.content: The contract emanating eerie light floated before Chen Ji, the God-Slaying Blood Pact using Heavenly Fate as ink and lifespan as parchment, each stroke radiating a chilling pressure. The projection of the Heavenly Eye watched him silently, as if observing an ant about to fall into a web. "Sign it, and you gain the qualification to rewrite fate." The voice carried no emotion whatsoever. "Refuse it, and your fate ends here."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at the blood pact, yet deep within his pupils flickered a light entirely different from his expression. Rewrite fate? He coldly laughed in his heart. If he didn't dare sign even this, how could he deserve the title of Tianji Record inheritor? His finger gently touched the edge of the blood pact, and a scalding pain instantly spread from his fingertip throughout his entire body.

text.content: The moment the blood pact contacted his blood, a crisp shattering sound echoed from within his Mental Sea—the fourth page's seal was breaking. Chen Ji felt his vision go dark as he was pulled into a vast, endless sea of stars. Countless points of light swirled around him, each representing a node of fate.

dialogue.content: A虚幻的声音从识海深处传来，带着几分欣慰与警告："终于走到这一步了，小子。但你要记住——命运书写者并非无代价的神明。你每改写一个节点，便要承担对应的反噬。这反噬可能是寿元，可能是天命，也可能是你最珍视之人的命运。"

text.content: Chen Ji stabilized his mind and surveyed his surroundings. Those points of light gradually became clear—there was a golden point representing himself, tightly bound by a black line of fate, that was Ling Yuan's pursuit—and at the end of that black line lay an outcome that made his heart shiver: death.

choice.prompt: Facing the fate of being pursued by Ling Yuan, how would Chen Ji respond to this first fate rewrite?

choices.description: Forcefully sever the pursuit line using the Fate Scribe ability, regardless of the cost
choices.visible_reward: Completely Change the Course of Fate
choices.risk_hint: The backlash may be extremely severe

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, his divine sense forming into a pen condensed from golden light. Without hesitation, he stabbed toward the core node of that black line of fate—the moment when Ling Yuan's pursuit would succeed. Light exploded, and he felt his lifespan within his body rushing away madly.

choices.description: First rewrite a tiny node to test the ability, then act after understanding the limitations

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, fixing his gaze on an extremely small branch of that black line—the unexpected variable along the pursuit path. He gently wrote, and that branch instantly dissolved, but a strange sense of weakness immediately袭来.

choices.description: Before making a decision, first ask Mo Xiansheng about the specific limitations and rules of the Fate Scribe

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his finger and asked coldly: "What are this ability's limitations? Must I pay an equal price for each rewrite, or are there other rules?" Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment, as if weighing how much to reveal.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly materialized, his illusory face carrying a complex expression: "The rules are simple—fate is balanced. When you rewrite someone's fate, that karma must be borne by someone. You bear it, or... those you love bear it." His voice grew low, "This is also why all previous inheritors of the Tianji Record ultimately met tragic ends."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes slightly hardened. He thought of his missing sister Chen Nian, of the girl taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." If the backlash from his fate rewriting fell upon her... An unprecedented rage burned in his chest. But he quickly suppressed his emotions, his lips instead curling into a cold smile.

dialogue.content: "Since that's the case—" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold, "I'll rewrite one of Ling Yuan's fate nodes and see exactly how terrifying this backlash is." He gathered his divine sense pen once more, this time without hesitation, directly stabbing toward the most crucial node on that black line of fate—the moment of successful pursuit.

text.content: Golden light flashed, and Chen Ji felt something within him being drawn out. Not Heavenly Fate Value, not lifespan, but something deeper—his fate trajectory was being forcibly twisted. That feeling was like someone carving an unhealable scar upon his soul. Pain, burning, tearing—three sensations attacked simultaneously, nearly making it impossible for him to breathe.

choice.prompt: At the crucial moment of rewriting fate, Chen Ji felt intense backlash. How should he adjust his strategy?

choices.description: Grit his teeth and endure all the backlash to ensure the rewrite succeeds
choices.visible_reward: Completely Change Ling Yuan's Pursuit Fate

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, allowing that soul-tearing pain to spread throughout his body. His hair whitened by a few strands in that instant, and fine wrinkles appeared on his facial skin. But that black line of fate—snapped.

choices.description: Attempt to transfer part of the backlash to other objects or substitutes

text.content: Chen Ji took out a substitute talisman from his storage bag, which he had spent a fortune to purchase from a wandering cultivator years ago. Channeling part of the backlash into it, the talisman instantly turned to ashes, and the pressure he felt greatly reduced.

When the golden light faded, Chen Ji found himself back in his Mental Sea. That black line of fate that had once tightly bound him was now fragmented, yet not completely gone—it was reorganizing in a strange way, changing from pursuit to... confusion. Ling Yuan's fate trajectory would forever bear an unsolvable mystery.

dialogue.content: At that moment, the Heavenly Eye's voice sounded again, carrying a barely perceptible hint of approval: "Well done, you have proven your qualification. From this day forth, the Fate Scribe's ability will be fully open to you. But remember—every fate you rewrite will, someday in the future, return to you in some way."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, finding himself still standing in place, but everything around him had changed. He could see the threads of fate flowing through the air, could hear the whispers of heavenly workings. The God-Slaying Blood Pact had vanished, replaced by a golden mark seared into the depths of his divine sense—the proof of the Fate Scribe.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at his own hands, feeling that unprecedented power within his body. His lips slowly curved upward, revealing a dangerous smile: "Ling Yuan, the fate of your pursuit has been rewritten by me. Now, let you properly experience... the taste of having your fate manipulated by others." His voice was ice-cold and confident.

text.content: Meanwhile, in the Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect, thousands of miles away. Ling Yuan was in meditation when suddenly he spat a mouthful of blood, his eyes snapping open. His eyes were filled with disbelief—just now, he had discovered that the fate line pursuing Chen Ji... had snapped. Not blocked, not diverted, but directly... vanished.

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" Ling Yuan's voice trembled, "The rewriting power of the Tianji Record has been lost for ten thousand years, how could..." He rose abruptly, spiritual energy surging around him, shattering everything within several zhang. But no matter how he sensed, he could not find the whereabouts of that rewritten fate line. It was as if something had... completely erased it.

text.content: And within the depths of his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time with solemnity: "Boy, you've stepped onto this path, there's no room for retreat. Remember, every stroke of the Fate Scribe must be considered with extreme care. Today you rewrote Ling Yuan's fate, tomorrow new karma will come knocking."

Chen Ji nodded, firmly记住了墨先生的话。He raised his head, gazing toward Tianqing Sect in the distance, his eyes flashing with dangerous light. Ling Yuan's pursuit had been temporarily shattered, but this was merely the beginning. He still had more plans to complete—Chen Nian's whereabouts, the Holy Sect's schemes, the Heavenly Eye's true purpose... everything was just beginning.

dialogue.content: He轻声自语，声音里带着几分期待："命运书写者……有意思。既然上天给了我改写命运的能力，那我就让这天下，都按我的棋局来走。"His smile carried a brilliance intertwined with madness and calm—that was Chen Ji's true face.
